hints.title: Count Total Ones
hints.text: Count total occurrences of 1 across the whole string in an initial pass.

hints.title: Split Points
hints.text: A split at index i divides the string into non-empty left part s[0..i] and right part s[i+1..n-1].

hints.title: Running Zero and One Counters
hints.text: As i progresses from 0 to n - 2, maintain zeros_left and ones_right = total_ones - ones_left. Maximize the sum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting zeros and ones for every split point takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking running counts in a single pass takes linear time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate ensures left and right parts are non-empty and computes score dynamically.
complexity.notes: Split index goes from 0 up to n - 2.
